EnorasisLink: How enorasisCore talks to the micro:bit.
enorasisCore:
enorasisCore: connect the micro:bit to browser Machine Learning (enorasiscore.eu).
The AI runs in the browser; the micro:bit receives class labels over Bluetooth (BLE UART)
or over the USB cable (serial, 115200 baud). Both arrive as one line per class.
enorasisCore.classIs: Returns true when the last class label received from enorasisCore equals the given name.
enorasisCore.classIs|param|name: the class label to compare against, eg: "left"
enorasisCore.connection: How enorasisCore is connected right now: "Bluetooth", "USB", or empty when it is not connected.
enorasisCore.isConnected: True while enorasisCore is connected, over Bluetooth or the USB cable.
enorasisCore.lastClass: The class name last sent by enorasisCore AI (e.g. left, red, go).
enorasisCore.onAnyClassReceived: Run when the AI in enorasisCore detects any trained class.
enorasisCore.onClassReceived:
Run code when enorasisCore sends this exact class label.
The label must match the class name you trained in enorasisCore (same spelling and case).
enorasisCore.onClassReceived|param|class: the exact class label to listen for, eg: "left"
enorasisCore.onConnected: Run code when enorasisCore connects, over Bluetooth or the USB cable.
enorasisCore.onDisconnected: Run code when enorasisCore disconnects, over Bluetooth or the USB cable.
enorasisCore.send:
Send a short message from the micro:bit to enorasisCore in the browser,
over the connection in use. The learning environment shows it in the board card.
enorasisCore.send|param|text: the message to send, eg: "A pressed"
enorasisCore.start:
Start enorasisCore over Bluetooth and the USB cable.
Kept so that projects made with older versions keep working.
enorasisCore.startWith:
Start enorasisCore so the browser can send AI class labels to the micro:bit.
Choose Bluetooth, the USB cable, or both.
enorasisCore.startWith|param|link: how enorasisCore connects: Bluetooth, the USB cable, or both
